name: Prism
notes: Separate logins per Space (new Spaces start empty; copy logins from any Spaces). Import bookmarks and history from Chrome, Edge, Brave, Vivaldi, Opera, Firefox. Quiet update and default-browser cards instead of dialogs; update badge on the Rail. Fixes the endless restart-to-update loop. Web apps editor with real logos. Dial frame-rate cap now enforced. Scrollable command sheet without duplicates. New Prism background. Draggable window.
